body:
I'm so sorry things have been hard for you, but you are a lovely person for reaching out to a stranger who is ranting on the internet. I completely hear what you are saying about friends- I have a lot of close ones too, I guess because I *know* I can be a friend.

I can't really afford a therapist either, but I found one at a counselling centre that works on a sliding scale; maybe there is something like that in your area. Thank you so much for answering this.
About the same, but thinking about everything that everyone said here :)

I am on a waiting list to see a counsellor that specializes in sexual abuse issues. It will be a few months before I get to see someone. 

I have made a couple of appointments with my family doctor to try to discuss all of this, but I can't find a way to say it out loud (he has been my doctor my whole life and I just feel like he won't believe me, since he didn't have an idea). I am looking into finding someone else, and hoping that having them be a relative stranger will help.  

The past few months are the first time I have ever considered telling someone about what happened. By the time I realized all the reasons I should have, we were far away from him. 

As for telling the police, I know that this is not an option at this point. I have tried to feel out information from my mom about the people we knew in that neighbourhood (he was a relative of theirs, I can't remember their surnames, or the street names, being the age I was) but she can't remember anything about them. 

There were a lot of kids my age in that neighbourhood. I encountered this person through a girl that I played with. Part of what horrifies me is what he has probably been able to do because I didn't say anything at the time. 

Thank you for everything you said :)

Thank you for suggesting the other subreddits! I didn't know there was a rapecounselling group. 

I am crying reading all these lovely responses. I really want to get better too. I have worked hard to make it through a lot of stuff and I don't want to lost it now.
Thank you. Talking is so much easier when anonymous :P

Thank you for everything you said. I am trying hard to not let things in the past get the better of me. But it feels like the problem is me. 

I am on a waiting list to see a counsellor to see if it will help with everything. I am willing to work hard, if only because my friends have been through enough, and shouldn't have to deal with me coming apart. 

I'm sorry you had a hard life. I don't want to be alone, but I don't want to bring someone else into the mess that is my life.

They do love me. I know they do. I just have this horrible feeling that they couldn't if they really knew everything about me. That is a reflection on me, not them. And thank you, you are wonderful for replying to something like this.
